text:
zoe: beginning onboarding checks for cobalt-mini-v1 (384d) against wiki+support corpus. aim: MRR, recall@1/5/10, cluster consistency (AMI), and HNSW recall parity vs our 768d baseline (horizon-768). sampling 8k docs, will test hnsw vs ivf and metric cosine vs dot.
mike: nice. what quant path?
zoe: baseline runs in fp16 for horizon; cobalt will be int8 GPTQ path + a separate dynamic-quant probe. also try per-tensor int6 for an extreme comp test.
ana: quick note: 384d might change neighbor sparsity — please compute mean neighbor distance and density ratio slices.
a na: (typo) ana: also capture MRR and hit-rate (HR@k) for the short-query slice. those are sensitive.
zoe: initial fp16 run for cobalt (hnsw, raw dot) results:
```
MRR: cobalt 0.56 | horizon 0.62
Recall@1: 0.61 | 0.68
Recall@5: 0.83 | 0.87
Recall@10: 0.90 | 0.93
AMI (kmeans 80): 0.33 | 0.41
Mean neighbor dist (k=10): 0.42 | 0.36
Density ratio (top clusters): 1.25 | 1.05
```
zoe: baseline gaps especially in MRR and AMI. suspect dimensionality contraction on fine-grained intents.
mike: can you paste a few short-query misses (query -> expected / top1)?
zoe: sample failures:
- "where is my refund" -> expected "refund process" / got "invoice timeline"
- "vpn not connecting" -> expected "vpn troubleshooting" / got "network policies"
- "change username" -> expected "account settings username" / got "profile update"
these look semantically related but specificity lost.
evan: try L2-normalize + cosine metric. also test HNSW ef_search tune (ef=128) — sometimes recall lifts for small dims.
zoe: re-run with cosine + norm and hnsw ef=128, ef_construction kept default. batchsize 96.
evalbot: queued eval job job_2026_03_22_cobalt_v1; sample=8k; configs=[cobalt-fp16-hnsw-dot, cobalt-fp16-hnsw-cosine, cobalt-gptq-int8-cosine, horizon-fp16-hnsw]. ETA ~ 9m.
ana: while that runs, please compute UMAP for cluster ids with AMI drop and include silhouette for comparison.
zoe: cosine+norm+hnsw results:
MRR: 0.60
Recall@1: 0.65
Recall@5: 0.85
Recall@10: 0.91
AMI: 0.38
Mean neighbor dist: 0.39
Silhouette (kmeans 80): 0.18

zoe: MRR and AMI improved significantly after metric change. short-query top1s fixed for 2/3 examples.
mike: good lift. how's GPTQ int8?
evalbot: gptq-int8 run finished:
MRR: 0.57
Recall@1: 0.62
Recall@5: 0.84
Recall@10: 0.90
AMI: 0.35

evan: int8 shows small degradation but within tolerance for @5/@10; MRR dip noticeable. we should consider canary with fallback. also check p50 latency microbatch=32. cobalt should be ~12% lower memory and slightly faster.
ana: int6-pertensor run was catastrophic (MRR 0.49). dropping that for now.
zoe: proposal: promote cobalt-fp16-hnsw-cosine to a read-only canary for semantic search at 5% traffic, and cobalt-gptq-int8-cosine as a cheaper variant in dedicated offline indices. Canary policy: if MRR delta <= -0.04 for 30m, route to horizon-768 fallback. Add a monitor for AMI drop >0.05 and high density_ratio >1.2 in any cluster.
mike: +1. add a short-query prompt augmentation experiment to the canary (prefix short queries with "Q:") and monitor HR@1 for that slice.
evalbot: hooks created: monitor_id=mon_cobalt_mrr_20260322; alert if MRR delta <= -0.04 for 30m.
evan: infra: I'll reserve a warm HNSW shard to keep ef_search stable during the canary. Also will surface p50/p95 traces to the console.
zoe: final checklist items: (1) add 200 example short-query promptset to the rollout; (2) include UMAP snapshot and AMI baseline in PR; (3) perf run p50 microbatch=32. I'll open rollout PR after attaching artifacts.
mike: please include exact index params (M, ef_construction, ef_search) in the PR.
ana: and multilingual slice test for spanish/pt. dims may interact with translations.
zoe: will do. closing thread to create PR. thanks all. :rocket:
